note: The original description (Fan 1983) could not be obtained; the entry is compiled from the species-level account and measurement table in the Isoptera volume of Fauna Sinica, soldier only.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, nasus reddish brown and fading towards the base, antennae near the head colour, anterior part of the pronotum slightly darker, thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellow. Head almost bare with faint fine hairs, the back of the vertex with 2 long hairs, the tip of the nasus densely covered with short hairs, 4 long hairs at the fontanelle near the tip of the nasus. Head nearly circular, nasus like a slender cone, without a distinct elevation in lateral view, forming a straight line with the vertex; each mandible with 1 short spine. Antennae mostly 13-segmented, segment 2 short, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 about equal to or shorter than segment 2; in the 12-segmented antennae segment 4 is longer than segment 3. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the median notches of the anterior and posterior margins indistinct. Measurements (mm, mean in parentheses): body length (to the tip of the nasus) 3.84—4.66 (4.26); head length including nasus 1.71—1.78 (1.76); head length without nasus 1.00—1.03 (1.02); head width 1.03—1.09 (1.05); head height (without postmentum) 0.69—0.78 (0.72); pronotum median length 0.22—0.25 (0.23); pronotum width 0.50—0.52 (0.51); hind tibia length 1.03—1.08 (1.06).

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Distribution: Xinfeng, Jiangxi. Original description in Fan 1983, Contributions from the Shanghai Institute of Entomology 3: 208—209.
